protocol.status: Exploratory post-hoc analyses, reused evaluation years; not independent final validation.
protocol.model: LogisticRegression C1 max_iter1500; industry/region onehot + scaled opening year; neighborhood variables interact with industry.
protocol.train: 365day: year-6 through year-2; 1095day: year-8 through year-4. All training outcomes mature before Jan1 evaluation year.
protocol.weights: building modes: inverse records per building-year for training, normalized to training n; inverse records per building for evaluation. Changes estimand, not deduplication.
protocol.region_period: 2018-2022, complete1095days; pooled industry opening-year distribution standardizes each region.
limitations: Current snapshot coordinates and region reconstruct history; relocation/reporting availability unknown.
Permits are not unique businesses; missing building IDs fall back to record IDs.
Removing <=30day outcomes is sensitivity only, changes target population, not deployable filtering.
All spatial features count raw eligible permits, including same-building neighbors; outcome weighting does not remove feature duplication.
No spatial cluster confidence intervals, multiple-testing adjustment or causal claim.
Regional n30/year display flag and spatial n200/events20 screening are not statistical significance.
Specific exposure fits only use 2016-2024 generated named counts; 3year models do not use these columns.
